info.title: ExeMem cloud API
info.description: Target contract for the unified ExeMem cloud (storage + auth) HTTP API. info.version is the cloud protocol version. This file is the design machine spec; when it and docs/designs/cloud-api.md differ, this file wins for paths, auth, and errors. Cutover is a clean break from /api/cloud/backups/v2 — no dual paths.

CloudProtocolHeader.name: X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol
CloudProtocolHeader.description: Cloud protocol version. Must equal info.version for storage routes. Checked before body decode. LastDBNode.token.version must match.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Developer key with em_ prefix in header X-API-Key. Used on storage routes (native create dual-auth, blob context/prepare/complete). Not used to manage developer keys — those auth-service routes use accountBearer.

lastDbNode.description: Authorization: LastDBNode <base64url(NodeReadToken JSON)>.<base64url(64-byte Ed25519 signature)>. Signature is over NodeReadToken::digest of the raw HTTP body. Domain lastdb:share:node-read-authority:v1. Token.version must equal X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol.

githubOidc.description: DEV-only GitHub Actions OIDC JWT. Issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, audience lastdb-dev-snapshot.

accountBearer.description: Saved account credential from enrollment / backup connect. Authorization: Bearer <account_api_key>. Used by auth-service developer-key and payment routes. Distinct from the em_ developer key (X-API-Key) used on storage dual-auth routes. A client needs this bearer to create its first em_ key.

ProtocolError.description: Stable protocol error. code is for programs; field is a static name.

UpgradeRequired.description: Caller protocol version is missing or below the service minimum.

JsonObject.description: Opaque JSON object for design inventory. Implementation fills exact properties from cloud_backup_protocol when types are generated.

DecimalU64.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as a decimal string (never binary64).

HexDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 or Ed25519 public key material as used on the wire.

Id.description: Protocol Id (database id, upload id, stream id).

field.description: Static protocol field name. Never a credential, URL, key, or record body.

ProtocolError.description: HTTP mapping: not_found 404; unauthorized 403; generation_conflict/identity_conflict/predecessor_conflict 409; resource_limit/quota_exceeded 413; provider_pending 202; outcome_unknown/retry_later 503; upgrade_required 426; else 400. Payment uses unauthorized with field payment.subscription.

minimum_version.description: Lowest cloud protocol version this service accepts.

CreateDatabaseRequest.description: Exact fields follow cloud_backup_protocol / mutation_log create body at implementation. Inventory placeholder keeps deny-unknown.

MutationLogAppendRequest.description: Append batch; exact Entry/Writer shapes come from mutation_log at codegen time.

SnapshotAction.description: Body action discriminator for POST /api/cloud/v3/snapshots. Matches storage_service snapshots Request enum (2026-11-19).

SnapshotRequest.description: Tagged by action. Exact per-action fields are filled at codegen from the service enum. additionalProperties false is enforced per action variant in generated types.

ciphertext.description: Standard base64 ciphertext when result is bytes.

MemberSetRequest.description: Publisher-signed entries; exact MemberEntry schema from cloud_backup_protocol at codegen.

SettingsSetRequest.description: Publisher-signed ShareSettings statement. Cloud stores and returns it; does not interpret member_writes. People owns Share/Deliver/Org presets.
